_readme: Site readiness per road. site_status: 'compatible_assumed' = corridor layout suits a 2-wheeler flyover (assumed from layout, NOT field-verified); 'unknown' = no site data yet. To upgrade a road later, edit its entry here - no code change needed.

Bommanahalli.notes: Straight road with a metro in the median, 2 lanes each side and a service road. Considered feasible for a 2-wheeler flyover until site data is recorded.
open_items: Pillar spacing and clearance beside the metro viaduct
Space for ramps and merge/diverge geometry
Utilities and drainage along the alignment
Structural/geotechnical review
Road-safety audit and statutory approvals
